Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-25T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Decision roadmap canvas + initial MAP gdoc

Jordan — great talking yesterday. As promised, I put together a lightweight decision roadmap canvas to align stakeholders and shorten the path to an internal POC. The goal: a one-page MAP the team can own that covers evaluation milestones, technical blockers to unblock, and procurement steps.

High-level proposal: 
- Week 0: quick integration checklist + test dataset access
- Week 1–2: 2 small POCs (chat & embeddings) with baseline perf/cost metrics
- Week 3–4: acceptance tests and security sign-off
- Week 5–8: pilot scale + final commercial proposal

Next steps I'm proposing: I shared a draft MAP (link below) — could you loop in procurement and a technical lead? If you share a preferred date/time I’ll run a 30-min workshop to walk through assumptions and land owners.

Draft MAP: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1MAP_v3 (MAP_Template_v3.gdoc)
90d cadence slides: https://slides.redwood/90_day_eval_cadence (90_day_eval_cadence.gslides)

Attachments: MAP_Template_v3.gdoc (Google Doc - draft), 90_day_eval_cadence.gslides (Slides - draft)

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
